## Pre-registered backtest grid

Under the [shared rules of round 1](https://github.com/Acusick1/odds/issues/821).
- threshold ∈ {0.01, 0.02, 0.03} × decision times ∈ {[60, 30], [120, 60, 30]}: 6 cells.
- Lines are fixed at {1.5, 3.5}. Bet a line only when the exchange's own price on it is absent or within 2 pp of the model.
- `max_input_age_minutes`: 10.
